func (*Recorder) Append(ctx context.Context, event RecordedEvent) error
func (*Recorder) Follow(ctx context.Context, after uint64, target bitwire.Wire) (*duplex.Follower, error)
func (*clientEvents) Settled(ctx context.Context, data protocol.Outcome) error
func (*clientMethods) Supervise(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Supervise) (protocol.Outcome, error)
func (*serverMethods) Describe(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Ticket) (string, error)
func (*serverMethods) Start(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Start) (protocol.Job, error)
func Declared(access bitwire.Wire) (duplex.Declared, error)
func FromWire(ctx context.Context, wire bitwire.Endpoint, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (protocol.ServerModel, error)
func PrepareFromWire(wire bitwire.Endpoint, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (complete func(context.Context) (protocol.ServerModel, error), cleanup func(), err error)
func Record(ctx context.Context, target bitwire.Endpoint, log duplex.WireLog, options duplex.RecordOptions, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (*Recorder, error)
func ToWire(model protocol.ServerModel, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (bitwire.Endpoint, error)
type RecordedEvent interface{recordedEvent()}
type RecordedSettled struct{Data protocol.Outcome}
type Recorder struct{}
